name: CentralSquare
description: Ingests CentralSquare Public Safety Suite Professional CAD data from the Pro Suite REST API - active calls for service are written to CloudTAK Events with their dispatched units as Assignments, AVL unit locations are posted to the map.

permissions.description: CentralSquare posts AVL unit locations to the map when DataType is Units
CentralSquare creates an Event for every active call for service
CentralSquare looks up the Event previously created for a call for service when its cache has no record of it
CentralSquare updates Events as calls for service change and ends them when the call closes
CentralSquare assigns the units dispatched to a call for service to its Event
CentralSquare reads the Assignments of an Event to reconcile them with the units currently dispatched
CentralSquare updates the role of an assigned unit as its status changes
CentralSquare removes units that are no longer dispatched to a call for service
CentralSquare geocodes call for service addresses that have no coordinates via the CloudTAK search API

schedule.description: Polls the Pro Suite CAD API for active calls for service or unit locations on a schedule.
